temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual. When Jose asks if she is okay, she says it is personal and thanks him, but does not share details. She appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose generally knows Patricia as vibrant and has not previously suspected that something serious might be troubling her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he moves from no known concern to suspecting Patricia is dealing with a personal problem.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be troubled by personal matters, but she is not ready to disclose them; she values his supportive offer.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer non-pressuring support and listen if she chooses to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During lunch, Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. In conversation, she confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and responds positively to the idea of discussing budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose suspects Patricia has a personal problem, but he does not know its nature; she has appreciated his support without sharing details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; his vague concern is confirmed and focused on financial stress, and he learns she may be open to practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is under financial stress and might welcome help with budgeting or financial planning when she feels ready.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, empathy, and motivation to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to discuss budgeting or financial planning and wait for her to take him up on it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that he was not prying and says she is grateful for his offer to help. She appreciates his support as a friend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia has financial stress and may welcome help, but he worries he may have overstepped by bringing up financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; his worry about boundary-crossing is resolved by Patricia's reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia does not view his concern as intrusive; she appreciates his support and friendship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting her as a friend while respecting her privacy and boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is all good and she plans a quiet weekend. She thanks Jose and says she will keep his offer in mind, but she does not share details. Jose senses that she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support and does not think he was prying, though she may still be dealing with personal or financial stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he refines his understanding: she appreciates concern but likely prefers privacy and self-management.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his support but wants privacy and prefers to handle her issues herself; he should not press.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, warmth, and slight restraint.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Remain available and check in lightly without prying; give her space.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling it, thanks Jose for checking in, and tells him his support is really great. Jose continues offering practical help such as grabbing coffee.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support but prefers privacy and may be managing her own issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; it confirms that she is managing and values his consistent supportive presence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her current situation and appreciates Jose's steady support at work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular supportive check-ins and offer practical help without intruding.
